section: Communication satellites - INSAT and GSAT series, applications, transponder capacity

accepted.s: The South Asia Satellite is designated as which of the following?
accepted.x: The South Asia Satellite is designated as GSAT-9.
accepted.tq: Direct identification of a satellite designation.

accepted.s: GSAT-9, the South Asia Satellite, was launched in which month and year using GSLV-F09?
accepted.x: GSAT-9 was launched in May 2017 by the GSLV-F09 launch vehicle.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the closely placed launch year and vehicle details.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the beneficiaries of the South Asia Satellite:
1. Nepal and Bhutan were beneficiaries.
2. Bangladesh and Sri Lanka were beneficiaries.
3. Maldives and Afghanistan were beneficiaries.
4. Pakistan participated as a beneficiary.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Maldives and Afghanistan were beneficiaries. Pakistan opted out and therefore Statement 4 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the single wrong participant in a membership list.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes CMS-03, also designated GSAT-7R?
o: A weather satellite launched by GSLV-F09 for cyclone-warning services
A commercial communication satellite placed in low Earth orbit by LVM3-M6
An encrypted satellite providing anti-jam naval links up to 2,000 km from the coast, launched by LVM3-M5
A navigation satellite providing regional positioning services through PSLV
accepted.x: CMS-03/GSAT-7R is associated with encrypted, anti-jam naval links extending up to 2,000 km from the coast and was launched using LVM3-M5.
accepted.tq: Match the satellite with its specific defence application and launch vehicle.

accepted.s: CMS-03/GSAT-7R was associated with which of the following launch and operational details?
o: GSLV-F09, May 2017, regional satellite services for South Asia
LVM3-M6, November 2025, commercial broadband links in low Earth orbit
LVM3-M5, November 2025, encrypted anti-jam naval links up to 2,000 km from the coast
LVM3-M5, November 2024, exclusive weather observation over the east coast
accepted.x: CMS-03/GSAT-7R is linked with LVM3-M5 in November 2025 and supports encrypted, anti-jam naval links up to 2,000 km from the coast.
accepted.tq: Split the options by comparing launch vehicle, date and mission purpose.

accepted.s:
With reference to BlueBird Block-2, consider the following statements:
1. It weighs 6,100 kg.
2. It was associated with LVM3-M6.
3. It is described as the largest commercial communication satellite in low Earth orbit.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: BlueBird Block-2 is associated with LVM3-M6, weighs 6,100 kg and is described as the largest commercial communication satellite in low Earth orbit.
accepted.tq: Verify a three-part description by checking weight, launch vehicle and orbital status.

accepted.s: The early-warning capability of INSAT-3D and INSAT-3DR has had which of the following effects?
o: It sharply reduced cyclone-related deaths on the east coast, including Andhra Pradesh.
It provided encrypted naval communication up to 2,000 km from the coast.
It made BlueBird Block-2 the largest satellite in low Earth orbit.
It enabled the South Asian countries to opt out of satellite services.
accepted.x: INSAT-3D and INSAT-3DR early warnings sharply reduced cyclone deaths along the east coast, including Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the concrete consequence of a satellite-based warning system.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: INSAT-2 — first fully indigenous INSAT series
KALPANA-1 — first South Asia regional communication satellite
INSAT-3DR — first fully indigenous INSAT series
accepted.x: INSAT-2 was the first fully indigenous INSAT series. KALPANA-1, not GSAT-9 or INSAT-3DR, was the first exclusive weather satellite.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure satellite-series and first-achievement pair.

accepted.s: KALPANA-1 holds which distinction in the Indian satellite programme?
o: First fully indigenous communication satellite series
First satellite for encrypted naval links
First commercial communication satellite in low Earth orbit
accepted.x: KALPANA-1 was India's first exclusive weather satellite.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of a first-in-category distinction.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events or developments in chronological order:
A. Launch of GSAT-9 as the South Asia Satellite
B. Launch of CMS-03/GSAT-7R
C. Association of BlueBird Block-2 with LVM3-M6
D. Recognition of BlueBird Block-2 in APPCA 2026
Which of the following is the correct sequence?
accepted.x: GSAT-9 was launched in May 2017, CMS-03/GSAT-7R relates to November 2025, and BlueBird Block-2 is associated with LVM3-M6 and APPCA 2026 thereafter.
accepted.tq: Use the first dated event and then place the 2025 and 2026 developments.
